references.text: Here it speaks of swearing by heaven, which is God's throne, creating a direct connection to Jesus' words in Matthew 23:22 that swearing by heaven is the same as swearing by God's throne and by Him who sits on it.
This verse highlights heaven as God's throne and earth as His footstool, echoing the image in Matthew 23:22 of swearing by God's throne.
Refers to Jesus sitting at the right hand of God's throne, linking to the idea of swearing by Him who sits on God's throne, as mentioned in Matthew 23:22.
